{{short description|Legislative district of the Philippines}} {{Use mdy dates|date = May 2020}} {{Infobox constituency |name = Davao Occidental's at-large congressional district |towns = |area={{convert|2,163.45|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} |population = 317,159 (2020){{cite web|url=https://psa.gov.ph/sites/default/files/attachments/ird/pressrelease/Region%2011.xlsx|title=Region XI (Davao Region)|website=Total Population by Province, City, Municipality and Barangay|publisher=[[Philippine Statistics Authority|PSA]]|accessdate= July 8, 2021|author=Census of Population|date=2020}} |electorate = 192,420 (2022) {{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=2022NLE/Statistics/2022RVVAVmcocfinal|title=Number and Turn-Out of Registered Voters and Voters Who Actually Voted by City/Municipality May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections|website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=April 21, 2023}} |parl_name = [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |region= [[Davao Region]] |region_label=Region |district=[[Davao Occidental]] |district_label=Province |caption2=|image2= |caption = Map of the Philippines showing the location of Davao Occidental |image = File:Ph locator davao occidental.svg |members_label = Representative |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Nationalist People's Coalition}}|border=darkgray}} [[Nationalist People's Coalition|NPC]] |blank1_name = Political party |members = [[Claude Bautista]] |blank2_info = Majority |year=2013 }} '''Davao Occidental's at-large congressional district''' is the [[Congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district of the Philippines]] in [[Davao Occidental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 2016. It was previously included in [[Davao del Sur's 2nd congressional district]] from 1987 to 2016. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Claude Bautista]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC).{{cite web|title=House Members|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/|publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]]|accessdate=April 21, 2020}} == Representation history == {| class="wikitable" ! rowspan="2" |# ! colspan="2" rowspan="2" |Image ! rowspan="2" |Member ! colspan="2" |Term of office ! rowspan="2" |Congress ! rowspan="2" |Party ! rowspan="2" |Electoral history |- !Start !End |- | colspan="10" style="text-align:center;" |District created October 28, 2013 from [[Davao del Sur's 2nd congressional district|Davao del Sur's 2nd district]].{{cite web|title=DavSur voters approve of Davao Occidental|url=http://r11.pia.gov.ph/index.php?article=1561383119470|last=Cayon|first=Carina L.|date=30 October 2013|work=Philippine Information Agency|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131203033933/http://r11.pia.gov.ph/index.php?article=1561383119470|archive-date=3 December 2013|accessdate=7 November 2013}} |- | rowspan="2" |'''1''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|Liberal Party (Philippines)}};" | | rowspan="2" | | rowspan="2" |[[Lorna Bautista-Bandigan]] | rowspan="2" |June 30, 2016 | rowspan="2" |June 30, 2022 | style="text-align:center;" |[[17th Congress of the Philippines|17th]] | [[Liberal Party (Philippines)|Liberal]] |[[2016 Philippine House of Representatives elections|Elected in 2016]]. |- | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|Nationalist People's Coalition}};" | | style="text-align:center;" | [[18th Congress of the Philippines|18th]] | [[Nationalist People's Coalition|NPC]] | [[2019 Philippine House of Representatives elections|Re-elected in 2019]]. |- | rowspan="2" | '''2''' | style="color:inherit;background:{{party color|Lakas–CMD}};" | | rowspan="2" | [[File:Rep.
